sentences.en: The pencil you used to write the poem was blunt.
sentences.zh: 你用来写诗的铅笔已经很钝了。

sentences.en: Sami locked himself in the bathroom to smoke a blunt.
sentences.zh: 萨米锁在浴室里抽了一支大麻烟卷。

sentences.en: A love triangle has at least two blunt angles.
sentences.zh: 至少有两个直角的爱情三角形。

senses.zh: 使变钝：less sharp; 减弱（力度等）：

mnemonic: 发音记忆：“不拦的”→口无遮拦的→率直的
